name: iZap
description:
Connect iZap to manage your WhatsApp customer conversations without leaving the chat. Check how your day is going at a glance — message volume, how much your AI assistant is handling versus your team, and how long conversations are taking. Search and read your chat history, look up contacts, and send WhatsApp messages or approved templates on the spot. Launch broadcast campaigns with a preview step before anything goes out, and track their delivery. You can also set up and fine-tune the AI assistants that reply to your customers — create a new one or update its instructions in seconds.

Everything runs against your own authenticated iZap business, so you see your real numbers and your real conversations.

_published_faq.name: How do I add iZap to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add iZap to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://izap.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the iZap MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: iZap lists 21 MCP tools, including confirm_transmission, connect_whatsapp_number, create_ai_assistant, create_transmission_preview, get_assistant_instructions, get_chat_messages, get_conversation_breakdown, get_conversation_duration, get_more_tools, get_today_assistant_ratio, get_today_message_stats, and get_transmission_status.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to iZap?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to iZap in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
iZap requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
iZap is developed by iZap Labs. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
